portfolio.target: Sharp endpoint barrier identification with interval-valued or missing scores, and exact limits on extrapolating local obstructions through additive backgrounds.
portfolio.cheapest_test: Derive endpoint-separated max-min formula and product-background formula; falsify against exhaustive small graphs before scale-up.
portfolio.success: A correct explicit theorem or informative counterexample, comparison to widest-path and fitness-landscape prior work, useful distinction from existing sufficient bound.
portfolio.failure: Demote standard corollaries; retain only exact limitations and validated software.
